detail.longDescription: K4I Street K4I Street is a personal productivity and information management application designed to help users organize important parts of their daily life in one private and modern space. The app brings together useful tools for managing passwords, plans, schedules, training, studying, cooking, and work activities. K4I Street is being developed as a web and mobile application with a focus on simplicity, practical features, modern interface design, and an organized user experience. Main Features Password management Personal agenda and plans Training plans Study planning Cooking plans Work planning Modern dark interface Web and Android support K4I Street is an ongoing project created and developed by Adam El Guermat. # android # privacy # productivity # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community k4i street app
